focus_areas: Legibility and coherence of text on the menu covers and inner pages.
Structural integrity of the menu folds and edges against the table.
Realism of food textures (sushi and fried items) compared to the menu.
Perspective consistency of the table setting.
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'text_gibberish' artifact. In AI images, menus often fail at the character level. If the fine_grained_classifier says 'menu' but the image_text_auditor finds no readable words, this is a significant alignment vs. artifact conflict. Also, check if the food looks 'plastic' or overly smooth, which often accompanies AI-generated scenes with text.

Critical for verifying if the text is legible and semantically correct or if it suffers from AI-generated gibberish/artifacts.
